title: Add a skill to an existing Claude plugin

name.description: Skill name (kebab-case, e.g. review-terraform). Becomes the skill directory and the frontmatter name.

project.description: Plugin to add the skill to: a folder path (e.g. plugins/payments) or a plugin/marketplace name (equals the Nx project name).
project.x-prompt: Which plugin (folder path or plugin name)?

description.description: Frontmatter description. Keep it third-person and include "Use when …" trigger conditions — lint enforces this.

userInvocable.description: Mark the skill user-invocable (writes `user-invocable: true` to the frontmatter).
